Worst Bench Decision

Jason Harle got the win on the scoreboard. His bench still has a complaint.

Montgomery had a front-row seat

Owner & benched player
Jason H • David Montgomery
Bench points vs. flex starter
Montgomery 28.90
Terry McLaurin 3.40
Missed points from one eligible swap
25.50 points

Montgomery scored three touchdowns on Jason's bench. Starting him in the W/R/T slot instead of McLaurin would have lifted Gotham Knights from 121.46 to 146.96. Jason still finished ahead of Dillon's 94.86 with both starting lineups done, so it cost bragging rights rather than the win. This is the largest single eligible bench-to-starter improvement among players who have finished so far; Monday's bench performances could change the award.
